items.label: Viavi Q4 FY2026 (08-05-2026)
items.signal_prefix: RECORD CLOSE TO FY2026 - TEST DEMAND IS TRACKING

set.signal: FY2026 ENDED ON A STRONG NOTE (CEO) - TEST DEMAND IS TRACKING THE DATA-CENTER BUILD. FQ4 revenue $443.1M, ABOVE the high end of the $427-437M guide, +8.9% QoQ and +52.5% YoY; operating margin 24% (+960bps YoY, above the 22.2%-23.2% guide); EPS $0.34 (guide $0.29-0.31). NSE $353.9M, +69.2% YoY - including $47.7M from the acquired SPIRENT product lines - with NSE gross margin 64.1% and NSE operating margin 20% versus 4.6% a year ago. OSP $89.2M (+9.6%) on 3D sensing and anti-counterfeiting, 40% operating margin. FULL YEAR FY2026: revenue $1.518B (+40% YoY, Spirent product lines contributed $145M), operating margin 20.6% (+630bps), EPS $1 vs $0.47. Total cash and short-term investments $656.7M at quarter end. FQ1 FY2027 guide: revenue $450-460M (NSE $360-368M, OSP $90-92M), operating margin 27.1% +/-40bps, EPS $0.40-0.42. Viavi is adding one week to the first quarter of fiscal 2027 (it adds one week to the first fiscal quarter every five or six years), bringing some elevated variable costs; CEO: any extra revenue is 'de minimis' because 'Most of our revenue is shipped in the last four weeks of the quarter', while opex is linked to the number of weeks. Viavi received approximately $11M of tariff refunds in July 2026; CFO: 'The operating margin includes a net benefit of about 100 basis points from the tariffs refund, which will be offset by the additional one week of variable costs, and it will primarily benefit NSE's operating margins.' Structural margin view (CEO): NSE gross margin is 'north of 60%' (low 60s on some field instruments to the high 70s on some lab products), so as NSE grows much faster than OSP 'the gross margin will continue to creep up'; 'our OpEx is growing much slower than our revenue'; 'I would say if we continue on this trajectory, I think mid to high 20% operating margins in a not too distant future is probably the expectation.' THE $500M QUARTER (CEO): 'I think the $500 million will likely come a bit sooner than what we were originally thinking, given the trajectory and the growth' - originally talked about for fiscal 2028, now 'I'm looking like sometime in calendar 2027.'
set.figure: FQ4 rev $443.1M (+52.5% YoY), op margin 24%, EPS $0.34; FY26 $1.518B (+40%); $500M quarter likely sometime in calendar 2027 (CEO)

items.reason: 'RECORD' is not stated (CEO: 'ended on a strong note'); the follow-on offering / Term Loan B payoff are financing terms (dropped); '14-WEEK' is the analyst's wording (the CFO said one added week); 'cash' was cash and short-term investments; the CEO's hedges on the mid-to-high-20s margin view and the $500M timing were lost; EPS '$1.00' was not the stated '$1'.
items.evidence: I would say if we continue on this trajectory, I think mid to high 20% operating margins in a not too distant future is probably the expectation.

items.label: Viavi Q4 FY2026 (08-05-2026)
items.signal_prefix: DATA CENTER IS NOW ~50% OF NSE REVENUE - AND IT IS ALL OPTICAL

set.signal: DATA CENTER IS NOW ~50% OF NSE REVENUE - AND IT IS ALL OPTICAL. CEO Khaykin: 'our data center is now running at about 50% of the NSE revenue. A&D is, I would say, probably about 17%, the rest is our service provider business.' 'pretty much when we talk about data center, it's all optical' - optical on the R&D / lab side, optical for production test, optical for fiber monitoring and the data center build-out - 'There's very little copper or anything, if anything at all.' CEO: 'I think that business, even if I take out Spirent, it's more than doubled for us year-over-year.' The fastest-growing piece is production: 'it's everything from making fiber optic modules to making fiber optic cables to now getting into the CPO testing, where we're entering the traditional semiconductor test. We play the optical plane of the semiconductor test, and that's a completely new market.' Product: Viavi launched what the CEO called 'the industry's first validation solution for Ultra Ethernet transport, which is purpose-built to support large-scale AI and high-performance computing workloads'; CEO: 'we are ahead of schedule on the roadmap integration' with Spirent, and the integration was done as of the June quarter. Spirent: CEO 'September quarter, they're going to be up around 10% in revenue, and December is usually their strongest quarter'; CFO 'we see at least 10% quarter-over-quarter growth from June to September'. Capex read-through (CEO): 'If you tell me somebody's spent this year $600 billion and next year they're going to spend $1 trillion, I should expect at least that kind of growth'; 'In some of these cases, we're not even present, but we will be present with 1.6 Tbps so that our market actually going to expand. I think on this particular product lines, we should do better than the purely CapEx growth.' A&D: 'We expect PNT to be a multi-year growth driver for our A&D business.' Service provider was up on fiber monitoring for fiber build-outs and cable instruments for the DAA cable architecture migration, while wireless sees 'the same anemic, although stable, customer demand'.
set.figure: Data center ~50% of NSE (A&D ~17%); DC business more than doubled YoY ex-Spirent (CEO: 'I think'); Ultra Ethernet Transport validation solution launched

items.reason: 'for the first time this precisely' was editorial; the CEO's 'I think' on the more-than-doubled data-center business and on beating capex growth was lost; 'industry's first' is the company's claim and is now attributed; quotes restored to the speaker's words.
items.evidence: I don't want to give out percentages, but let's put it this way: I think that business, even if I take out Spirent, it's more than doubled for us year-over-year.

items.label: Viavi Q4 FY2026 (08-05-2026)
items.signal_prefix: SPEED-NODE, CPO AND OCS ROADMAP FROM THE TEST SEAT

set.signal: SPEED-NODE, CPO AND OCS ROADMAP FROM THE TEST SEAT. SPEED MIX (CEO): 'If I look at today in terms of sheer volume, 800 Gbps is still the biggest driver, but 1.6 Tbps is ramping very quickly, and that's mainly a lot of the production'; 'I would say probably, in 2027, it may get to probably parity between 800 Gbps and 1.6 Tbps, and then 1.6 Tbps will continue to get bigger while 800 Gbps may pull back'; 400 Gbps 'is going to be around for quite a while as well. They just don't go away' - multiple nodes running in parallel. CPO (CEO, asked for a timing update): he dismissed industry talk that CPO would be slower because of yield - 'That's all nonsense. CPO and all that thing is moving forward. Are there issues? Of course there are'; 'From my perspective, it's progressing, and I have POs to show for that.' Asked whether CPO revenue still begins in the fall, he said yes: 'We're already getting some this quarter, and probably in December it will start accelerating.' Yield management raises test intensity: 'To manage yields, you just do more tests. You do more of a known good die, known good optical engine, known good substrate, and all these kind of things. Which means a lot of testing, which ultimately pretty good for us.' Why CPO (CEO): 'if you have a co-packaged optics, your three nanometer silicon performs as a two nanometer silicon. You are getting almost a whole node of advantage by co-packaging the optics' - taken either in performance or in cost; 'it comes at a much higher cost, but relatively speaking, if you get the same performance with the older silicon node, then it's worth it.' OCS (CEO): 'There is some OCS, I think majority of OCS probably will be coming in the next revenue, will be coming in the next several quarters'; Viavi has 'been selling equipment to a big OCS vendor, hyperscaler, who makes their own stuff', and 'many other companies are looking to do more optical switching in their core. I see this demand as being very healthy.'
set.figure: 800G/1.6T probably at parity in 2027, then 1.6T leads; some CPO revenue this (Sept) quarter, probably accelerating in December; CPO = almost a whole node of silicon advantage (CEO)

items.reason: Hedges lost: the CEO said CPO revenue 'probably in December it will start accelerating' and 'I think majority of OCS probably will be coming' in the next several quarters; the parity quote was not his wording; 'the cleanest statement yet' was editorial.
items.evidence: We're already getting some this quarter, and probably in December it will start accelerating.
